title: Handwritten inscription Good
ingredients: 1 lb. flour, dried and sifted.  1/4 lb. butter, and half as much lard.  1 saltspoonful salt. A pinch of soda, thoroughly dissolved in just enough vinegar to cover it, and well worked in.  Enough ice-water to enable you to roll out into paste half an inch thick. Cut into squares, prick with a fork, and bake light brown. Split, butter, and eat while hot.
